For hearing 9f Main Case Mr. Habibullah Ghouri, advocate for the petitioner Mr Ashique Ali Jatoi, advocate for respondents No 5 and 6 M٢ Abdul Waris Bhutto Asstt: A.G along with SIP Ghulam Mustafa Jagirani, ٥٨ behalf of SSP Kamber Shahdadkot and Inspector Naeem Akhtar Abro, SHO, PS Nasirabad The Official respondents No 1 t0 3 filed statements through learned Assistant AG which are taken on record Mr. Ashique Ali Jatoi, learned counsel places Vakalatnama on behalf of respondents No5 and 6 The official respondents states that there is private dispute going-on between the petitioner and private respondents have not harassed the petitioner and the allegations leveled against them are false and fabricated and there is no truth in it Learned Assistant AG contended that the official respondents will act strictly in accordance with law He further submits that have not harassed the petitioner 25 claimed by him Learned counsel for respondents No5 and 6 contended that there is dispute going-on between the parties for which they will avail legal remedy according to law Learned counsel for petitioner submits that he will be satisfied if the official respondents are directed to provide lawful protection to the petitioner and strictly in accordance with law In view of above position, the petition is disposed of along with listed applications (if any) by directing the official respondents not t0 harass the petitioner and provide protection to the petitioner as and when required strictly in accordance with law.
